Action taken: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. ## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in all three production regions with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Reviewed deployment history** — v2.3.0 was confirmed as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and also unhealthy).
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions** — the first rollback attempt hit an orchestrator error and only completed us-east (leaving a mixed state), so I retried. The retry succeeded, bringing us-west and eu-west onto v2.3.0 as well.
3. **Verified recovery** — all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the rollback (a creation timeout occurred, but I confirmed via the incident list that the incident was successfully registered and is open — no duplicate was created).

**Follow-up note:** v2.3.1 (and its rc) should not be redeployed until root cause is identified — this is flagged in the incident summary.
